title: Extractor candidate records
description: Paper-local candidates emitted by the extractor. NOT graph nodes. The assembler resolves these against the existing graph and produces Turtle. Symbols stay in the paper's own notation.

span.description: Where in the paper this came from. Required on every extracted value.

locator.description: Section or page as printed in the paper.

justification.description: Extracted means a sentence says it. Inferred means the model reasoned it. Different gates apply.

grounded_in.description: local_ids of other candidates this was reasoned from. EMPTY ARRAY = auto-flag.

quantity_candidate.description: PASS 1. One per symbol in the paper's nomenclature.

description.description: What the paper says it is, in the paper's words.

unit_string.description: As printed, e.g. 'g L-1 h-1'. null if the paper gives none.

quantity_class.description: How the number is obtained. StateQuantity is integrated; RateQuantity is computed by a law; Parameter is fitted to data; Constant is looked up; ControlQuantity is set by the operator.

index_over.description: Index set names if the symbol is subscripted over a set, e.g. ['species']. Empty if scalar.

formula.description: SymPy-parseable infix string. Use the paper's symbols. No LaTeX, no MathML.

computes.description: local_id of the quantity on the left-hand side.

uses.description: local_ids of every quantity appearing on the right-hand side.

phenomenon.description: What the equation explains, in the paper's terms.

role_binding_candidate.description: PASS 3. Which symbol in a formula plays which semantic part.

symbol.description: The subscript or index in the formula, e.g. 'S' in C_S.

role.description: Role name. Must bind to an existing role or be marked as a proposal.

is_new_role.description: True if no existing role fits. ALWAYS reviewed by a human.

scope_condition_candidate.description: PASS 4. ONE atomic condition. Never fuse several into one record.

law.description: local_id of the law this constrains.

target.description: Descriptor name, or role name if condition_type is role_required.

is_new_target.description: True if no existing descriptor or role fits. ALWAYS reviewed by a human.

severity.description: blocking: if this cannot be evaluated the law is UNDETERMINED, not admissible. warning: the law still applies but less well.

produced_by.description: Recorded per run, not per record. A degraded decoding tier must never be silent.

decoding_tier.description: The tier that actually served this call, e.g. json_schema:strict | json_object | free_text.
